\caption{pgphase's pipeline. The reads are aligned by other tools (grey, dashed boxes), and dromos makes the graph's site catalog and indexes the graph alignments by reference position (green); pgphase's steps lie inside the dashed outline. The graph arm (blue) phases the catalog's sites from the walks the reads' graph alignments take through them; union gap phasing (orange), which runs only when a linear alignment is given, adds the sample's own heterozygous variants. One expectation-maximization phases all sites, joining blocks only where reads verify the join; local windows and a second pass follow, then chunk stitching, the rescue and island blocks label the remaining reads, and pgphase writes a phased VCF and the reads' haplotype tags.}\label{fig:overview}
